title: Antigravity MCP Configuration
description: JSON schema for Antigravity Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configurations (mcp_config.json)

$schema.description: URL or relative path to the JSON schema.

mcpServers.description: Map of MCP server identifiers to their transport and capability configurations.

mcpServer.description: Configuration for an individual MCP server. Must use either Stdio transport (local command) or SSE transport (remote HTTP endpoint).

command.description: The executable or command name to launch a local stdio MCP server process (e.g., 'node', 'python3', or binary path).

args.description: Command-line arguments to pass to the local MCP server command.

env.description: Environment variables to inject into the local MCP server process.

cwd.description: Working directory in which to execute the local MCP server process.

serverUrl.description: The HTTP(S) URL of the remote MCP server SSE endpoint.

headers.description: HTTP headers to send with requests to the remote MCP server (e.g. Authorization, X-goog-user-project, API keys).

authProviderType.description: Authentication provider type for remote MCP server (e.g., 'google_credentials', 'GOOGLE_OAUTH', 'AUTH_PROVIDER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED').

disabled.description: Whether this MCP server is disabled.

enabledTools.description: Allowlist of tool names exposed by this server. If specified, only matching tools are enabled.

disabledTools.description: Denylist of tool names to exclude from this server.

timeout.description: Execution timeout for requests sent to this MCP server (supports milliseconds or seconds).

timeoutSeconds.description: Execution timeout in seconds for requests sent to this MCP server.

skipToolNamePrefix.description: Whether to omit the server name prefix in the names of exposed tools.

skipToolDescriptionPrefix.description: Whether to omit the server name prefix in tool descriptions.

forceAllToolsEager.description: Whether to force all tools from this server to be eagerly loaded into context.

strictArgumentValidation.description: Whether to strictly validate tool arguments against tool parameter schemas.

omitFromSystemPrompt.description: Whether to omit this server's tools from the generated system prompt.

oneOf.title: Stdio Transport
oneOf.description: Local executable transport communicating over standard input and output (stdio).

oneOf.title: SSE / HTTP Transport
oneOf.description: Remote MCP server communicating over HTTP using Server-Sent Events (SSE).

toolsSetting.description: Tool configuration options for this MCP server. Can be a granular map of tool names to per-tool options, a server-level setting object, or a list of tool names.

oneOf.description: Granular map of tool names to per-tool configuration.

eager.description: Whether all tools from this server should be eagerly loaded into agent context rather than lazy-loaded.

oneOf.description: List of tool names to expose from this server.

mcpToolConfig.description: Configuration options for an individual tool exposed by this MCP server.

eager.description: Whether this tool should be eagerly loaded into agent context rather than lazy-loaded.

background.description: Backgrounding execution mode for this tool.

mcpTaskOptions.description: Task management options for long-running tool executions.

suppressCompletionNotification.description: Whether to suppress notifications when this task finishes execution.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for background tasks created by this tool.

description.description: Description of background task progress and purpose.

mcpOAuthConfig.description: OAuth 2.0 configuration for remote MCP authentication.

scopes.description: OAuth permission scopes required by the remote MCP server.
